reason: I'd maybe download the free version because the doctor PDF sounds useful before I push for a PCOS workup, but I already know I'll stop logging after two or three weeks. Paying $5 a month for an AI write-up of a log I won't keep up is paying for homework I'm not doing.
objection: Every tracker promises 'under a minute' and I still quit. A weekly AI summary is worthless if my log is half empty, and Flo already does most of this for free.
would_change_my_mind: If it filled in most of the log on its own from my phone or watch (sleep, steps, cycle) so I only tapped a couple of symptoms, and the Pro write-up actually got a doctor to take me seriously and order tests.
